zh.text: 实时日志新增级别筛选（全部 / INFO / WARN / ERROR）与「共 N 条 · 显示 M 条」统计条
系统日志中模组加载行显示彩色 MOD 徽章，跳过模组为琥珀色
修复账号管理「All statuses」与模组管理「All types」下拉筛选切换语言后失效
数据库管理「数据 / 结构」页签补齐多语言翻译
环境自检 9 张卡片的标题与说明文案随语言切换
实时日志正文随语言切换，新到的日志也会立即按当前语言显示，不再残留中文
修复顶部语言选择器选中文后按钮仍显示 English（语言名不再被翻译逻辑还原成旧值），底部状态栏环境自检文案同步翻译
模组页新增「作者身份」：本机 Ed25519 密钥身份（作者标识 + 密钥指纹），可改署名、导出/导入 .eve-key 备份还原身份
修复启动时首帧资源指标（CPU/内存/GPU/网络）拿不到的问题：tickMetrics 由 launcher-bridge.js 调度，内联脚本不再提前调用导致 ReferenceError
模组签名校验（Ed25519）：模组卡片显示「已签名 / 签名失败 / 未签名」三态，可用本机作者密钥一键签名；清单被改动后签名失效并禁止启用
模组页新增「创建模组」：以已跑通的 welcome-mod 骨架生成 evejs-launcher.mod.json + loader.js + README + CHANGELOG，带真实文件树预览，可选立即启用/立即签名（默认禁用）
模组页新增「提交模组」：一键重签 → 打包 ZIP(.NET) → 算 sha256 → 生成索引分片草稿，并可填写 GitHub 令牌用 API 自动 fork/建分支/开 PR（失败可降级为手动 PR 页面）
模组页新增「我创建的」：合并本地 / 索引 / 本机提交台账，显示 仅本地·待提交·已提交·已上架·已下架·本地比已上架新 六种状态，支持打开目录、提新版、打开 PR、导出 CSV
模组页新增「模组市场」：拉取签名索引（GitHub Pages + jsDelivr 双镜像 + 本地缓存 TTL 30 分钟），先验签再信任，按 EveJS 版本过滤不兼容条目
模组市场支持一键安装 / 更新：多镜像回退下载 + sha256 校验 + 进度条；已装模组走覆盖更新并保留启用状态、排序位置与用户设置
已安装页新增冲突横幅与加载顺序面板，一眼看出哪些模组冲突、实际按什么顺序加载
模组页布局调整：创建模组 / 提交模组 / 作者身份 / 模组制作规范 四个按钮移到「模组市场」页签右侧；启动器底部「主服务启动维持时间」初始显示 --:--:--
修复「我创建的」页签点下去像没反应：该页不再等待联网拉索引（改为只读本地缓存），并且页签与动作按钮改用脚本绑定，切换立即生效
修复「我创建的」「模组市场」列表非空时不显示的问题：渲染函数用到了只存在于 bridge 内部的 esc()，导致每次渲染抛 ReferenceError、网格不更新（表现成点页签没反应）
模组卡片字段统一：显示「简介」作为说明，类型标签 LOADER 改为「分类」，id/restart 行改为「标签 / MOD大小 / 本地版本」；分类改为下拉菜单（玩法·经济·AI·画面·工具），创建模组与提交模组表单同步
模组新增「详情」弹窗：作者·分类·版本、状态徽章、最新/本地版本·体积·重启要求·互斥模组·兼容版本·来源 八项统计、功能要点、模组说明（读 README.md）与本次更新，底部可直接打开目录 / 重新签名 / 安装更新
签名归属保护下沉到主进程：清单里已声明别的作者标识、或 author.keyId 与本机密钥不一致时直接拒绝签名（渲染层的提示可以被绕过，这层必须在主进程）
提交模组弹窗去掉「国内镜像直链（Gitee Releases）」，只保留 GitHub Releases 直链（留空则由「② 发布到我的仓库」自动生成），相关多语言词条一并清理
修复底部「主服务启动维持时间」没保持 --:--:-- 初始化样式：指标每秒刷新时主服务未运行会写成 00:00:00，现在未运行就显示 --:--:--
删除模组页的 // LOAD ORDER 面板（DOM、渲染函数与调用一并移除）
搜索框右侧下拉从「全部类型（LOADER/SOURCE…）」改为「创建模组」的分类（玩法·经济·AI·画面·工具），已安装与模组市场两个列表都按分类过滤；没有分类的老模组显示「未分类」而不是 LOADER
模组卡片精简：撤掉签名相关显示（已签名/未签名/未验证徽章与卡片上的「签名」按钮，改由详情弹窗承载）；名字下面那行改为 MOD 标签，分类徽章移到右上角原签名位置；删掉 ENABLED/DISABLED 文字，「详情」移到左下角
模组卡片的「目录」改为「更新时间」（取模组目录内最新一次文件改动时间，如 2026-09-21 17:16）；详情弹窗的统计格也补上「更新时间」（现为 9 格）
修复创建模组弹窗「构建选项」三个勾选框错位：它们原来嵌在 .modal-field 里，被 .modal-field input{width:100%} 撑成整行、标签被压成逐字换行；现改为独立的 .cm-opts 行并把复选框宽度交还给浏览器原生尺寸
创建模组的模板预设英文化并标注为案例：Welcome Broadcast (Example) / Blank Skeleton，广播模板说明改为「加载模组后会在游戏本地聊天框看到一条『欢迎回来，飞行员』的信息」
修复切语言后多个弹窗仍显示中文：① 说明段里的行内 code/b 标签把整句拆成多个文本节点（现改为单节点整句翻译）② 字典里首尾带空格的 key 永远查不到（启动时统一去空格）③ 补上「我的第一个模组」「聊天, 新手」「这一版改了什么」等占位符与五个分类词条；并新增「切英文后扫描三个弹窗」的冒烟探针防回归
新增索引仓库脚手架（EVEjs-mods：sources.json + 作者仓库清单 + keygen 生成 Ed25519 密钥 + CI 抓取合并签名产出 mod-index.json + GitHub Pages 发布），并落地「id 先到先得 / author.id↔公钥绑定 / 来源可见」三条归属规则，已完成本地跨端验证
启动器内置索引签名公钥（BUILTIN_PUBKEYS），可验证 diguo520.github.io/EVEjs-mods/mod-index.json 的签名
模组市场增加「上次检查时间 + 检查更新」按钮，用户可主动强制刷新索引（不再受 30 分钟缓存限制）
索引仓库多镜像抓取（raw → jsDelivr → github/raw）+ 本地清单覆盖 INDEX_LOCAL_LISTINGS；下载镜像改为 jsDelivr 优先（国内可达性），并支持无 secret 时的本机手动构建发布
「模组市场」页签增加「N 可更新」徽章，并在启动时后台静默拉一次索引，不用点进市场页就能看到有模组可更新
修复两处语言问题：① 作者名按钮（如「指挥官」）会先显示中文再被翻译造成闪烁，改为直接用当前语言渲染；② 冲突横幅（都引用了服务端模块…）切换语言时不再即时刷新，已在切语言时重绘
模组市场顶部新增四张统计卡（市场收录 / 本地已装 / 可更新 / 累计下载，含精选数·合计体积·覆盖率·最热单品）；索引新增 downloads 字段，由 CI 读取作者仓库 GitHub Release 的下载计数，市场卡片上也会显示下载次数
模组三页签（已安装 / 我创建的 / 模组市场）的统计卡改为「同一个位置随页签切换内容」，不再每个页签各加一块统计；模组市场每张卡片新增自己的下载次数行（下载次数 + 体积 + 更新时间 + 本地版本），索引构建同时统计 GitHub Release 资产与 jsDelivr CDN 命中，模组统计相关文案补齐 7 种语言翻译
模组审核链路：索引仓库新增 moderation.json + scripts/moderate.mjs（list / approve / reject / delist / restore / pr-text），维护者可拒绝收录或从市场下架某个模组并填写中英原因；被下架的模组不再出现在市场且禁止安装，作者可在「我创建的」看到红色「已下架 / 已拒绝收录」徽章与具体原因

en.text: Realtime log gains level filters (All / INFO / WARN / ERROR) and a total/shown counter bar
Mod load/skip lines in the system log now carry a colored MOD badge (amber when skipped)
Fixed All statuses / All types dropdown filters becoming untranslatable after the first language switch
Localized the Data / Structure tabs in the database manager
Environment self-check cards now translate their titles and detail text with the UI language
Realtime log body now follows the UI language, including newly arriving lines, with no leftover Chinese
Fixed the top language switcher still showing English after selecting Chinese; the footer env self-check text now follows the language too
New Author Identity in the mods view: a local Ed25519 key identity (author ID + key fingerprint) with rename, and .eve-key export/import to restore it
Fixed the first-frame resource metrics (CPU/RAM/GPU/network) failing on startup: tickMetrics is owned by launcher-bridge.js and is no longer called too early by the inline script
Mod signature verification (Ed25519): mod cards show Signed / Invalid / Unsigned, one-click signing with your local author key, and tampered manifests are blocked from being enabled

New Create Mod in the mods view: scaffolds evejs-launcher.mod.json + loader.js + README + CHANGELOG from the proven welcome-mod skeleton, with a file-tree preview and optional enable/sign (disabled by default)
New Submit Mod in the mods view: re-sign, pack the ZIP, hash it, and build the index shard draft, then open a fork/branch/PR automatically via the GitHub API (with a manual-PR fallback)

New My Mods view: merges local mods, the index and your submissions into six statuses (local / draft / submitted / listed / delisted / local-newer), with open folder, new version, open PR and CSV export
New Mod Market: fetches the signed index (GitHub Pages + jsDelivr, 30-minute cache), verifies the index signature before trusting it, and hides entries incompatible with your EveJS version
Market install/update: download with mirror fallback, sha256 verification and a progress bar; updates keep the enabled state, load order and user settings
Installed view gains a conflict banner and a load-order panel so conflicts and the effective load order are visible at a glance
Mods layout: Create mod / Submit mod / Author identity / Mod authoring guide now sit to the right of the Mod Market tab; the status-bar uptime starts at --:--:--
Fixed My Mods appearing unresponsive: it no longer waits on a network index fetch (cache-only) and the tabs/actions are bound programmatically so switching is instant

Fixed My Mods / Mod Market showing nothing when the list is non-empty: the HTML render functions called esc(), which only existed inside the bridge, so every render threw a ReferenceError and the grid never updated

Mod card fields unified: shows the Summary as description, LOADER is replaced by Category, and the id/restart row becomes Tags / Mod size / Local version; category is now a dropdown (Gameplay · Economy · AI · Graphics · Tools) in both the create and submit forms

New mod details dialog: author/category/version, status chips, eight stat cells (latest/local version, size, restart, conflicts, compatible versions, source), highlights, description (read from README.md) and changelog, with Open folder / Re-sign / Install-update actions
Moved the signing ownership guard into the main process: signing is refused when the manifest already declares another author ID, or when author.keyId does not match the local key

Removed the China-mirror (Gitee Releases) field from the submit dialog — only the GitHub Releases direct link remains (leave it empty and step 2 fills it in automatically); the unused translation strings were dropped too
Fixed the status-bar main-server uptime not staying at --:--:-- until the server runs: the per-second metrics refresh used to overwrite it with 00:00:00
Removed the // LOAD ORDER panel from the mods view (DOM, render function and its call site)

The dropdown next to the search box now filters by the Create-Mod categories (Gameplay · Economy · AI · Graphics · Tools) instead of mod kinds, on both the Installed and Market lists; mods without a category show Uncategorized instead of LOADER

Streamlined mod cards: removed the signature indicators (Signed/Unsigned/Unverified badges and the on-card Sign button — the details dialog carries them now), the line under the name now shows the mod tags, the category badge moved to the top-right where the signature used to sit, ENABLED/DISABLED text is gone, and Details moved to the bottom-left
Replaced the card's Folder field with Updated (the newest file change time inside the mod folder, e.g. 2026-09-21 17:16); the details dialog grid gained the same Updated cell (now 9 cells)

Fixed the misaligned Build-options checkboxes in the create-mod dialog: they sat inside .modal-field, so .modal-field input{width:100%} stretched each checkbox to full width and squeezed the labels into one character per line; they now use a dedicated .cm-opts row with native checkbox sizing

Create-Mod presets renamed to English and marked as examples (Welcome Broadcast (Example) / Blank Skeleton); the broadcast template now reads "after loading you will see a Welcome back, pilot message in the in-game local chat"

Fixed Chinese left in several dialogs after switching language: inline code/b tags split sentences into fragments (now single-node sentences), dictionary keys with leading/trailing spaces never matched (normalized at startup), and added the missing placeholders plus the five category words; a new smoke probe scans all three dialogs after switching to English

Added the index-repo scaffold (EVEjs-mods: sources.json author list, keygen for the Ed25519 key, CI that fetches+merges+signs mod-index.json, GitHub Pages publishing) with the three ownership rules (first-come id, author.id↔key binding, visible source); verified end-to-end locally
The launcher now embeds the index signing public key (BUILTIN_PUBKEYS) so it can verify the signature of diguo520.github.io/EVEjs-mods/mod-index.json
Mod market gains a Last-checked time and a Check-for-updates button so users can force-refresh the index instead of waiting out the 30-minute cache

Index repo fetches author listings from multiple mirrors (raw → jsDelivr → github/raw) with an INDEX_LOCAL_LISTINGS offline override; download mirrors now prefer jsDelivr, and a secret-less manual build/publish path is supported
The Mod Market tab shows an "N updatable" badge, and the index is fetched in the background at startup so pending updates are visible without opening the market tab

Fixed two language issues: the author-name button flashed the raw Chinese before being translated (now rendered directly in the current language), and the conflict banner did not refresh when switching language (now re-rendered on language change)

The Mod Market gains four stat cards (in market / installed / updatable / total downloads with featured count, total size, coverage and top item); the index now carries a downloads field aggregated from GitHub Release download counts by CI, and cards show the download count

The three mod tabs (Installed / Mine / Market) now switch the content of one shared stats row instead of adding a separate stats block per tab; every market card gained its own download line (downloads + size + updated + local version), the index build now counts both GitHub Release assets and jsDelivr CDN hits, and the mod stats strings are translated into all 7 languages

Moderation pipeline: the index repo gained moderation.json plus scripts/moderate.mjs (list / approve / reject / delist / restore / pr-text) so the maintainer can reject a submission or delist a mod from the market with a bilingual reason; delisted mods disappear from the market and cannot be installed, while the author sees a red Delisted / Not accepted badge with the exact reason in My mods
